selection_rule.primary: Maximum unweighted mean of three fold macro-F1 scores
selection_rule.secondary: Maximum unweighted mean of three fold class-2 recalls
selection_rule.ties: Exact full-precision float equality; no rounding or tolerance
selection_rule.lr_simplicity: Lower C, then class_weight=None before balanced
selection_rule.rf_simplicity: Lower bounded max_depth (None last), larger min_samples_leaf, max_features sqrt before 0.5 before 1.0, then unweighted before balanced
selection_rule.eligibility: All three fits and predictions successful, finite selection metrics, and no ConvergenceWarning; other warnings are retained
selection_rule.failures: Structural/integrity violations stop the experiment. Model exceptions are recorded per fold and make the candidate ineligible; no parameter changes.
selection_rule.baseline_reproduction: Reference candidate OOF predictions must equal the saved baseline predictions when present, and reference metrics must agree within 1e-12

verification.runtime_note: Elapsed seconds include initial verification before journal started_at_utc
